attachments.name: medical_plan.txt
attachments.text:
Medical cover for the Westbrook Charity Run 5K, Sunday 7 February 2027

From Owen Cartwright, Club Chair, Westbrook Youth League

The race is a 5K with 450 runners and starts at 09:00. On-site ambulance cover is set out in the attached paperwork from Lifeline Event Medics.

First aid
Several of our members have done the first aid course through work, and they're happy to help out. We keep a good first aid box at the HQ tent, and another one goes in the lead car. In all our years we've only ever had blisters and scraped knees.

Heat, cold and water
There's water every 2.5 km. We look at the forecast two days before and again two hours before. Over 28 degrees we start earlier or cut the course, and over 32 degrees we call it off. If it's cold or wet, we have foil blankets and a warm tent at the finish.

If someone needs hospital
The nearest emergency department is at Harbourside Medical Centre, 6 km from the finish. We've walked the route out from the pick-up point at the top of Bridge Row with the first aiders, and we've told the hospital the date and how many are coming.

Staying in touch
We'll all have our phones, and I'll send a list of numbers round the team the week before. The signal is usually fine around there.

Who's responsible
Our medical lead is Yuki Tanaka, a registered paramedic, who'll be there from an hour before the start until the last runner is in and has the final word on pulling any runner out.
